code.title: Code
code.description: Code to be used in documents.

name.title: Name
name.description: Short name of the category to be used instead of the code in output.

title.title: Title
title.description: Human readable name of the category used for titles.

retained.title: Retained
retained.description:
When true, the tax amount will be retained by the buyer on behalf of the
supplier, and thus subtracted from the invoice taxable base total. Typically
used for taxes related to income.

informative.title: Informative
informative.description:
When true, the tax amount will be calculated and reported but will not affect
the invoice totals. Typically used for taxes that are embedded in the base
amount or don't impact the final payable amount.

keys.title: Keys
keys.description: Specific tax definitions inside this category.

rates.title: Rates
rates.description: Set of rates that can be used with this category.

extensions.title: Extensions
extensions.description:
Extension keys that may be used or required as an alternative to or alongside
a rate for the tax category. Every key must be defined in the regime's
extensions table.

sources.title: Sources
sources.description:
List of sources for the information contained in this category and most importantly,
an official source where the tax rates can be reviewed and updated in the future.

ext.title: Extensions
ext.description:
Extension key-value pairs that will be copied to the tax combo if this
category is used.

meta.title: Meta
meta.description:
Additional information about the category that is relevant for local frequently
used formats.

tax.CategoryDef.description: CategoryDef contains the definition of a general type of tax inside a region.

key.title: Key
key.description: Unique identifier for the key within the category.

name.title: Name
name.description: Human readable name of the key.

no_percent.title: No Percent
no_percent.description: When true, a tax combo using this key should not define a percent value.

tax.KeyDef.description: KeyDef defines a key that can be used inside a tax category.

rate.title: Rate
rate.description: Identifies the rate within the category.

keys.title: Keys
keys.description: Tax keys defined in the category that this rate can be used with.

name.title: Name
name.description: Human readable name of the rate.

values.title: Values
values.description:
Current and historical percentage values for the rate with additional filters.
Order is important; newer values should come before older values.

meta.title: Meta
meta.description:
Additional information about the rate that is relevant for local frequently used
implementations.

tax.RateDef.description: RateDef defines a single rate inside a category

ext.title: Extensions
ext.description: Extension codes used to filter whether this value applies.

since.title: Since
since.description: Date from which this value should be applied.

percent.title: Percent
percent.description: Percent rate that should be applied.

disabled.title: Disabled
disabled.description: When true, this value should no longer be used.

tax.RateValueDef.description: RateValueDef contains a percentage rate or fixed amount for a given date range.

sources.title: Sources
sources.description:
References to tax authority or other relevant documentation that can be used to
validate the regime's data and to check for updates and changes in the future.

time_zone.title: Time Zone
time_zone.description:
Location name for the country's central time zone. Accepted
values from IANA Time Zone Database (https://iana.org/time-zones). If a country has multiple
time zones, the most common or central one should be used.

country.title: Code
country.description:
Country code for tax purposes which usually coincides with the ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code, but not
always.

alt_country_codes.title: Alternative Country Codes
alt_country_codes.description:
Alternative localization codes that may be used to identify the tax regime
in specific circumstances.

zone.title: Zone
zone.description:
Specific Locality, region, city, province, county, or similar code inside
the country, if needed.

tax_scheme.title: Tax Scheme
tax_scheme.description:
Principal scheme of consumption tax that applies to the regime and is associated
with tax IDs in some export formats such as UBL or CII. Some regimes, like the
US, may not have a tax scheme and as a consequence will not use tax identities.

calculator_rounding_rule.title: Calculator Rounding Rule
calculator_rounding_rule.description:
Rounding rule to use when calculating the tax totals. See the RoundingRule
constants for more details. If not provided, the default is RoundingRulePrecise.

tags.title: Tags
tags.description:
Tags that can be applied at the document level to identify additional
considerations.

extensions.title: Extensions
extensions.description:
Keys that can be used for extended or extra data specific to the regime that
cannot be easily determined from other GOBL structures. Typically used to define
local codes for suppliers, customers, products, or tax rates.

identities.title: Identities
identities.description:
Identities used in addition to regular tax identities and specific for the
regime that may be validated against.

payment_means_keys.title: Payment Means Keys
payment_means_keys.description: Payment means keys specific to the regime that extend the base set.

inbox_keys.title: Inbox Keys
inbox_keys.description:
Inbox keys specific to the regime that identify where a document should be
forwarded to.

scenarios.title: Scenarios
scenarios.description:
Sets of conditions and rules that apply to a specific document schema. These
provide a more generic solution for normalization and validation of documents in
regimes with specific requirements.

corrections.title: Corrections
corrections.description: Configuration details for corrections to be used with correction options.

tax.RegimeDef.description: RegimeDef defines the holding structure for the definitions of taxes inside a country or territory.
